request: Same exact Babylon prompt and system message for untouched CCORE and every Astra checkpoint
primary_comparisons: Matched untreated BF16 CCORE versus adapter on same backend and seed
Astra appearance versus the preserved repaired CCORE visual reference, separately labeled

rating_scale.4: complete and convincing for the request

dimensions.criteria: Readable coherent town layout, navigable-looking spaces, canal/stalls/buildings connected logically; uncluttered viewpoint
Consistent voxel treatment, readable architectural silhouettes, material/color layering and small visible details
Visible actual GLB playback: walking or trading/carrying/gestures, moving water and clouds, palm or cloth movement; no clip-count-only credit
Finite geometry/transforms, intact materials/components, valid export and manageable complexity; shaders that do not survive GLB are counted as missing

raw_pass_gate: Actual unassisted generated code exports a nonempty GLB, zero validator errors, reimported visibly. Syntax-only/HTML-only/clip-count-only never passes. Fixed import-path localization and common frame-rate harness are disclosed. Other repairs scored in diagnostic lane only.
claim_rule: Call a clear win only when matched raw comparison shows better visible composition/detail/coverage or requested exported motion without a material regression in another primary dimension. Also compare with historical CCORE reference; a weaker-looking scene cannot win solely because fresh control crashed. Use mixed/no demonstrated improvement when evidence conflicts or no valid raw artifact exists. Weighted scores organize observations, not proof of statistical/general superiority.
review_views: Common viewer lights and normalized framing, overview plus detail angle
Same animation sample times0s/2s/4s and repeat-loop observation
Download/reimport each actual GLB; source preview motion scored separately if it differs
sampling_policy: Retain every generation, seed, finish reason and failed output. Prompt/settings never changed only for Astra. Historical reference stays immutable. If a diagnostic repair is made, retain exact patch and do not count it as training improvement.
non_goals: No claim of engine-specific import readiness without testing; no statistically significant/general model win from a single showcase.
reviewer: Current Codex visually inspects both models; optional authorized CLI critic supplies additional evidence only.
